summary: Iter 48 — Validated TWO new features: (A) Productivity Dashboard endpoint GET /api/central-ia/dashboard/productivity?days=30 and ProductivityCard in Atendimento IA → Central IA tab; (B) WhatsApp pre-notice notification endpoint POST /api/plans/scheduled-adjustments/{sid}/notify (Marco Civil 30-day compliance) plus the Notificar button wiring in PlansPanel. BACKEND: 14/14 pytest pass (1 skipped — no non-pending scheduled to test 409). Productivity envelope returns {items, team, days, generated_at}; each item carries all 21 required fields (user_id, name, role, conversations, messages_sent, frt_avg_seconds, aht_avg_seconds, csat_avg, fcr_rate, active_days, logged_seconds, in_conversation_seconds, idle_seconds, idle_pct, msgs_per_hour, returned_to_ai, ai_usage_pct, coachings_total, coachings_unread, coachings_acknowledged, productivity_score); team carries all 8 required KPIs; items sorted by productivity_score desc; best_performer/best_score match items[0]; days param validates 1-365 (422 outside); requires auth. AI agents excluded via is_ai_agent != true filter. Notify dry_run returns sent=0, sent_to[].phone/name/preview populated; default template includes 'olá' + 'reajuste' (Marco Civil pre-notice text); custom template substitutes {nome}=Maria (first name), {plano}=Fibra 500 Mega, {valor_atual}/{valor_novo} in BRL with comma decimals, {pct}, {data}; 404 on unknown sid; auth required; dry_run does NOT persist notified_at. FRONTEND validated via Playwright: login admin@empresa.com/123456 OK; Atendimento IA → Central IA tab renders [data-testid=ci-productivity-card] with all team mini-cards (Atendentes 1, Conversas 3, Msgs 0, CSAT 2, % Ocioso —, FRT médio 26m), 1 row [data-testid=ci-prod-row-usr-2100548587] for Administrador with red score circle '19' (<50 = red ✓), trophy icon next to top row, columns Score/Conv/Msgs/Logado/Ocioso/Thrpt/FRT/AHT/CSAT/IA%/Coach all present, Coach badge purple '6', legend footer 'Score = 40% CSAT + 25% volume + 20% adesão + 15% velocidade · FRT ideal: ≤5min · Ocioso saudável: ≤30% · Tempo logado: estimado por atividade (cap 8h/dia)' exactly matches spec. PlansPanel scheduled-notify-* testid exists in code (PlansPanel.js:913) but visual click test was blocked by Central de IA modal overlay during automation — backend integration however is fully wired and verified.

issues: With current seed data admin has logged_seconds=0 / messages_sent=0 → Logado shows '0s', Ocioso/Thrpt show '—'. This is correct because admin sends replies via Baileys auto-reply (no sent_by_user_id). For richer demo consider seeding a few outbound messages with sent_by_user_id set, otherwise the Throughput/Logado/Ocioso columns will look empty for new tenants.

action_items: (OPTIONAL) Seed/backfill sent_by_user_id on past outbound aihub_wa_messages so admin (and future attendants) accumulate logged_seconds and msgs_per_hour. Without it, scoring is dominated by CSAT (low here = 2.0/10) and the dashboard looks underwhelming.
(OPTIONAL) Productivity row Coach column shows the unread count (purple badge), but it's not labelled — consider tooltip 'X coachings não lidos'.
critical_code_review_comments: central_ia.py:739 — when weights_used==0 (user has no CSAT, no FRT, no logged seconds, but has messages_sent>0), volume can still raise weights to 25 and score is divided correctly. Edge case: if all attendants have messages_sent=0, the volume branch skips, weights may be 0 and productivity_score becomes None — this is handled by the `if weights > 0 else None` guard. OK.

central_ia.py:656 — in_conv_seconds = msg_count*300 is capped at logged_seconds. Reasonable heuristic but may underestimate Ocioso for users who write fewer/longer messages. Document the heuristic in dashboard tooltip.
plans.py:561 — fallback name when nickname AND name are empty is 'Cliente'. Good defensive default for the WhatsApp greeting.
plans.py:580 — sidecar returns 200 with {ok:false} on send failure path is handled as `failed += 1`. Network/HTTP errors also caught via try/except. Good.
plans.py:583-595 — insert into aihub_wa_messages with context='adjustment_notice' ensures these notices show up in the Lousa de Chat history. Good audit trail.

notify endpoint requires 'administrador' role only — gestor (which can SCHEDULE the adjustment via Plans CRUD) cannot send the notice. Worth aligning to gestor or documenting in UI (disable Notificar button for gestor).
Productivity endpoint requires 'gestor' (administrador inherits). Consistent with rest of central_ia.py.

success_rate.frontend: ProductivityCard 100% visually verified (all team KPIs, row columns, score circle color, trophy, legend). Notify button visual click blocked by modal overlay during automation but data-testid exists and backend fully validated.
